## Which ones need what

| | |
|---|---|
| **Nothing at all** | 02, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 |
| **A model download** | 01, 03, 04, 08 |
| **A running server** (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) | 06, 07, 09, 10, 12 |
| **A GPU, ideally** | 11, and the last cell of 15 |
